{{Top|leg}}
'''Candroidan hookworms''' were [[Parasite/Legends|parasites]] that were capable of supporting viruses specific to [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. The hookworm was responsible for the transmission of the [[Candorian plague/Legends|Candorian plague]] on [[Dentaal/Legends|Dentaal]] when [[Wilek Nereus]]'s team inoculated several thousand hookworms with the virus and salted a shipment of clothing to [[Calif City]].
